routing.limits: Manually authored synthetic wording groups in English. Training never consumes held-out phrases. Small test, shared domain vocabulary and mixed-topic failures limit generalisation. Diagnostic probes are separate from the test.

benchmark.limits: Single process, one caller, warm model. Repeats six short synthetic patterns (last may be truncated), including input validation, NLP, rules and brief creation. Latency percentiles use a uniform case reservoir (maximum 4,096). Excludes HTTP, UI, LLM and I/O. Throughput is a host-specific engineering measurement.
